statement: ∀ n : ℕ, y (ev y v n) = ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℂ) • ev y v (n+1)
proof:
intro n
have he (m : ℕ) : ev y v m = ((m.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • (y ^ m) v := rfl
rw [he, map_smul, he, pow_succ']
change ((n.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • y ((y ^ n) v) =
  ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℂ) • (((n+1).factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • y ((y ^ n) v)
rw [smul_smul]
congr 1
rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
have hn : ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
field_simp
